title: Unnecessary repeated fact entry
suspected_mechanism: The same professional fact might be independently re-entered where controlled reuse would be useful.
possible_effect: Potential extra effort or unintended divergence, if present in an actual case.
competing_explanation: Different wording/language/detail can be deliberate tailoring and has business value; low-frequency manual work may be appropriate.
supporting_evidence_needed: Observe the same fact/intent across an actual bounded case; label copy/re-entry versus intentional tailoring and record effort/context.
rejection_or_limit: Reject or narrow if no repeated entry is seen, variants are deliberate, or observed rework has another cause.
intended_response: Explicit selected reuse while preserving independent overrides is accepted target behavior; do not claim automatic propagation or measured time savings.

title: Ambiguity of intended shared variant
suspected_mechanism: Current tools/naming/availability/access context might make it difficult to identify the intended page/file/language.
possible_effect: Potential selection/retrieval correction or confusing access result.
competing_explanation: Multiple legitimate language/presentation variants or deliberate access restriction are not errors; availability failure may have a different cause.
supporting_evidence_needed: Record intended versus actually selected representation, applicable current policy, actual feedback and any correction in a controlled relevant case.
rejection_or_limit: Reject or narrow when intended meaning/selection is clear or differences are legitimate; do not label every differing file a defect.
intended_response: Separate selected publication, mode, link access and actual variant availability; no unrelated fallback or claimed clarity improvement without evidence.

title: Uncertain actual submission history
suspected_mechanism: Current recording may not preserve an identifiable actual set/event independently of later editable/live content.
possible_effect: Potential inability to establish what was actually sent or to interpret corrections.
competing_explanation: A trustworthy external archive/manual method may already exist; absence of inspected evidence is not evidence the history is absent.
supporting_evidence_needed: Inspect a permitted anonymized actual case and its material/provenance/recorded-time context, including deliberate resubmission/correction.
rejection_or_limit: Reject or narrow if existing actual history is reliably identifiable; do not infer failure from current source differing from an older actual copy.
intended_response: Explicit actual-material capture and distinguishable manual progress/corrections support intended traceability, not a proven reduced error rate.

title: Coordination/handoff friction
suspected_mechanism: Cross-tool/account/activity handoffs might obscure the next intended action or actual completion.
possible_effect: Potential retrieval effort, duplicated entry or missed defined follow-up.
competing_explanation: Tool separation may be intentional/effective; a late action may be user choice, changed deadline or unrelated interruption.
supporting_evidence_needed: Record an actual intended handoff/deadline/action/time meaning and observed outcome; distinguish external acceptance from receipt and actual reminders.
rejection_or_limit: Reject or narrow if handoffs work well or no agreed expectation was missed; tool-switch count alone proves no harm.
intended_response: Deliberate selected local/provider coordination and truthful outcomes address possible friction, not automatic send/sync or demonstrated productivity gain.

title: Work status versus actual accepted outcome
suspected_mechanism: Current item/task/board/Sprint meaning may be interpreted inconsistently across records or participants.
possible_effect: Potential ambiguous acceptance, period result or explicit incomplete-work disposition.
competing_explanation: Different status views can represent different valid subjects; work may intentionally be incomplete or not accepted.
supporting_evidence_needed: Inspect a real authorized work instance with explicit subject/criteria/period outcome and actual recorded disposition; no inference from dates/columns alone.
rejection_or_limit: Reject or narrow if interpretations are clear and correct; never call all tasks Done equivalent to accepted item.
intended_response: Maintain separate item/task/readiness/acceptance and coherent Sprint Backlog/actual end meanings; no automatic carryover or measured throughput claim.

possible_effect: Potential recheck/rework or unsafe repetition if such a case exists.
competing_explanation: Current external tools may already preserve correct revision/attempt context; no product hosting or unsafe runner has been observed here.

intended_response: Explicit revision/attempt/output and separate target authority constrain intended product behavior; actual interoperability/safety benefit needs evidence.

title: Admission/replacement/accounting uncertainty
suspected_mechanism: Current policy/usage/reference and completion meanings may not stay aligned during replacement, interruption or growth.
possible_effect: Potential false usable/freed-space result, rework or required-material loss if observed.
competing_explanation: Existing policy/procedure may handle this correctly; intentional rejection/retention is not a processing defect.
supporting_evidence_needed: Observe a bounded permitted case with actual effective policy/current references/usage and result; no cleanup/load on live data just to create evidence.
rejection_or_limit: Reject or narrow if actual semantics hold; do not infer capacity saturation from fixed allocation or a failed unrelated action.
intended_response: Effective reference-aware admission/cleanup and truthful partial results are proposed controls, not proven reclaimed capacity or a universal rollback.

title: Operational effort or dependency interruption pressure
suspected_mechanism: Required recurring maintenance/integration/recovery work might compete with the same limited owner time and shared resources.
possible_effect: Potential delayed operating response or engineering work if observed against defined expectations.
competing_explanation: Current actual workload may be small or managed by other mechanisms; 20 hours/week alone does not establish a bottleneck.
supporting_evidence_needed: Record a relevant authorized procedure/event and actual effort/wait/result/resource context; distinguish known absent backups from a measured outage or recovery duration.
rejection_or_limit: Reject or narrow if work fits the evaluated conditions; no schedule/resource/recovery conclusion from idle readings or no observed incident.
intended_response: Explicit operating scope, coverage/evidence and feasible work reconciliation support readiness; no additional staffing, service purchase or measured improvement claimed.
